	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 422 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 422 value = 2 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 423 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 423 value = 42 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 423 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 423 value = 3 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 424 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 424 value = 42 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 424 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 424 value = 4 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count key = 43 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count key = 43 value = 4 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 431 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 431 value = 43 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 431 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 431 value = 1 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 432 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 432 value = 43 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 432 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 432 value = 2 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 433 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 433 value = 43 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 433 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 433 value = 3 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 434 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_mechanic_id key = 434 value = 43 }
	remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 434 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_to_row key = 434 value = 4 }
	set_global_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_version value = 5 }
}

tv_wonder_index_rebuild_global_maps_if_needed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = tv_wonder_map_version } }
		tv_wonder_index_rebuild_global_maps_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:tv_wonder_map_version = 5 } }
		tv_wonder_index_rebuild_global_maps_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_is_unique } }
		tv_wonder_index_rebuild_global_maps_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_is_unique target = 1 } } }
		tv_wonder_index_rebuild_global_maps_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_index_clear_locked_wonder_cache_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_is_unique
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_base_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_size
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_style_count
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_display_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_concept_display_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_locked_image_display_id
}

tv_wonder_index_clear_selected_ritual_cache_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_wonder_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_mode
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_cost_type
}

tv_wonder_index_cache_locked_wonder_attributes_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_clear_locked_wonder_cache_effect = yes
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_index_key
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_index_key value = $wonder_id$ }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_local_variable = tv_wonder_index_key
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_is_unique
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_is_unique target = local_var:tv_wonder_index_key }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_is_unique value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_is_unique|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_base_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_base_id|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_mechanic_id|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_size value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_size|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_style_count value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_style_count|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_display_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_display_id|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_concept_display_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_concept_display_id|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked_image_display_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_image_display_id|local_var:tv_wonder_index_key)" }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_index_key
}

tv_wonder_index_cache_selected_ritual_attributes_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_clear_selected_ritual_cache_effect = yes
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_index_key
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_index_key value = $wonder_id$ }
	change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_index_key multiply = 100 }
	change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_index_key add = $style$ }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_local_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_index_key
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_ritual_key_to_id
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_key_to_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_ritual_index_key }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_key_to_id|local_var:tv_wonder_ritual_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_wonder_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_id_to_wonder_id|local_var:tv_wonder_ritual_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_style value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_id_to_style|local_var:tv_wonder_ritual_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_mode value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_id_to_mode|local_var:tv_wonder_ritual_index_key)" }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_selected_ritual_cost_type value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_ritual_id_to_cost_type|local_var:tv_wonder_ritual_index_key)" }
	}
	remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_index_key
}

tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_has_locked_wonder_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_index_cache_locked_wonder_attributes_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_locked }
	}
	else = {
		tv_wonder_index_clear_locked_wonder_cache_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_has_selected_ceremony_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_index_cache_selected_ritual_attributes_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_locked style = var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style }
	}
	else = {
		tv_wonder_index_clear_selected_ritual_cache_effect = yes
	}
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = yes
}
